Project.Name: pki-certificates.xml
Project.Title: PKI and Certificates: Hardening, Cloud PKI and the Lifecycle Platform

Task.Name: Wave 1 — Assess
K1.1 Every CA inventoried (host, key and signature algorithms, validity, root or issuing); every template's configuration and permissions exported
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: PKI and CA administrators Source: ../books/b07-pki/02-what-ad-cs-holds-up.md#what-the-certificate-inventory-collects

Task.Name: X-D04 Root of trust for device certificates decided (program D04)
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Program office (program) If decided late: The root of trust is chosen without the CA inventory, so BYOCA can't be weighed against the hierarchy that exists Source: program-master-schedule.md

Task.Name: K1.2 Hardening checks (ESC1 to ESC8) run against templates, CA settings and PKI object ACLs; CA auditing on
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: PKI and CA administrators Source: ../books/b07-pki/03-hardening-what-stays.md#the-esc-taxonomy

Task.Name: K1.3 Issued certificates inventoried by template with expiry; every relying party and the chains and CRLs it uses; strong-mapping sweep on every domain controller
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: PKI and CA administrators Source: ../books/b07-pki/07-coexistence-and-migration.md#the-migration-playbook

Task.Name: K1.4 Every template classified MIGRATE, BRIDGE, RETAIN or RETIRE against the template migration matrix
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: PKI and CA administrators Source: ../books/b07-pki/appendix-b-template-migration-matrix.md

Task.Name: K1.5 Critical and High hardening findings remediated and re-tested
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: PKI and CA administrators Source: ../books/b07-pki/03-hardening-what-stays.md#the-migration-gate

Task.Name: KG1 Gate 1 — Assessed and hardened
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: CISO and ISSO Criteria: Assessment approved by the PKI and CA administrators and the CISO and ISSO; no unclassified templates; every Critical and High finding remediated and re-tested (Chapter 03's migration gate); assessment record committed to the evidence repository Source: ../books/b07-pki/07-coexistence-and-migration.md#the-migration-playbook

Task.Name: X-P18S Program starts the Cloud PKI design and issuing CA (start of P1.8)
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform teams (program) If decided late: Under BYOCA, the root would sign a cloud issuing CA before its hierarchy passed the hardening gate Source: program-master-schedule.md

Task.Name: Wave 2 — Foundation
D-K1 Issuer for internal server certificates, and the lifecycle platform's edition
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Executive sponsor and CIO Options: Retained AD CS through the CLM platform, moving to a standalone issuing CA under the same root when the forest retires, and a public CA for names the internet trusts (Book 07's position); Certificate Manager, Self-Hosted, inside the boundary until a certificate-management package is FedRAMP authorized If decided late: Server certificates keep renewing by hand, and the Data Platform plan's replacement-CA decision (D-D9) has no issuer to name Source: ../books/b07-pki/04-the-target-pki.md#the-issuer-decision-for-internal-server-certificates

Task.Name: X-DD9 Replacement CA for SQL Server's certificates decided (Data Platform D-D9)
Task.Contact: CIO and data leadership (Data Platform Identity Transformation plan)
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: CIO and data leadership (Data Platform Identity Transformation plan) If decided late: SQL Server's certificates are given an issuer before the PKI plan has named one Source: data-platform.md

Task.Name: X-P18 Cloud PKI design done; issuing CA created (program P1.8)
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform teams (program) If decided late: There's no cloud chain to export or deploy, and the foundation waits Source: program-master-schedule.md

Task.Name: K2.1 Full chain exported; CRL and AIA reachable over HTTP from where relying parties sit; LDAP-only AIA replaced; root CRL on a published schedule
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: PKI and CA administrators Source: ../books/b07-pki/07-coexistence-and-migration.md#crl-availability

Task.Name: K2.2 Certificate Connector, current release, on its own servers wherever AD CS still serves SCEP or PKCS
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Endpoint engineering Source: ../books/b07-pki/06-device-and-user-certificates.md#keep-the-connector-current

Task.Name: K2.3 Every CA that issues user certificates, and the Federal PKI chain for PIV, uploaded to the Entra trust store with its CRL URL
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Identity engineering Source: ../books/b07-pki/06-device-and-user-certificates.md#the-trust-store

Task.Name: K2.4 Trusted certificate profiles for the cloud chain and the federal root on managed devices; the chain to domain-joined relying parties; NTAuth only for logon issuers
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Endpoint engineering Source: ../books/b07-pki/06-device-and-user-certificates.md#the-trusted-certificate-profile-comes-first

Task.Name: K2.5 Test certificate validated on every relying-party type; each CRL and AIA URL checked from inside, from the internet and in a test CBA sign-in
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: PKI and CA administrators Source: ../books/b07-pki/07-coexistence-and-migration.md#the-migration-playbook

Task.Name: K2.6 CLM platform deployed inside the boundary; its CA account scoped under the ESC7 review; Microsoft CA integration connected
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: CLM platform owner Source: ../books/b07-pki/04-the-target-pki.md#certificate-lifecycle-management

Task.Name: KG2 Gate 2 — Foundation in place
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: CISO and ISSO Criteria: Issuing CA active; trusted certificate profiles successful on at least 99% of managed devices; connector healthy; test certificate validated by every relying-party type; every CRL reachable from all three locations; the wave's rollback rehearsed in a test scope Source: ../books/b07-pki/07-coexistence-and-migration.md#the-migration-playbook

Task.Name: Wave 3 — Pilot
K3.1 CBA method policy for PIV acceptance: the four settings, high-affinity bindings, the authentication strength, staged rollout for pilot users within its limits
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Identity engineering Source: ../books/b07-pki/09-federal-workforce-credentials.md#how-entra-cba-uses-the-piv-authentication-certificate

Task.Name: X-P28S Program starts CBA for PIV holders (start of P2.8)
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform teams (program) If decided late: Pilot PIV holders are turned on for CBA before the method policy and bindings are set Source: program-master-schedule.md

Task.Name: X-P27S Program starts pilot certificate issuance (start of P2.7)
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform teams (program) If decided late: Pilot devices receive certificates no relying party has been shown to accept Source: program-master-schedule.md

Task.Name: X-P27 Cloud PKI certificates issued; Wi-Fi and VPN verified (program P2.7)
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform teams (program) If decided late: The pilot has nothing to observe, and Gate 3 waits Source: program-master-schedule.md

Task.Name: X-P28 Certificate-based authentication for PIV holders (program P2.8)
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform teams (program) If decided late: Pilot users aren't on CBA, and Gate 3 waits Source: program-master-schedule.md

Task.Name: K3.2 Pilot observed: Intune certificate reports and Entra sign-in logs read; binding and authentication level confirmed; failures to the troubleshooting runbook
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Endpoint engineering Source: ../books/b07-pki/08-lifecycle-monitoring-and-decommissioning.md#monitoring

Task.Name: KG3 Gate 3 — Pilot authenticates with cloud certificates and CBA
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: CISO and ISSO Criteria: At least 95% issuance success on pilot devices; no authentication failures caused by certificate configuration; pilot users on CBA at the intended authentication level; every pilot relying party accepts the cloud chain; AD CS autoenrollment still on for pilot devices Source: ../books/b07-pki/07-coexistence-and-migration.md#the-migration-playbook

Task.Name: X-G2 Program G2 — Pilot Clean
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Steward and executive sponsor (co-signed; program) If decided late: The program's pilot closes without the certificate pilot's evidence Source: program-master-schedule.md

Task.Name: Wave 4 — Scale
D-K2 Device rings for SCEP and user populations for CBA
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Endpoint engineering, with identity engineering Options: Follow the program's rollout waves; by site, region or device tier. Dynamic groups built from governed attributes If decided late: Production profiles can't be assigned, and Wave 4 waits Source: ../books/b07-pki/07-coexistence-and-migration.md#the-migration-playbook

Task.Name: X-P31S Program starts rollout wave 1 (start of P3.1)
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform teams (program) If decided late: The device rings have no divisions to follow Source: program-master-schedule.md

Task.Name: K4.1 SCEP profiles extended to production device groups, ring by ring, with the program's waves
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Endpoint engineering Source: ../books/b07-pki/06-device-and-user-certificates.md#scep-profiles

Task.Name: K4.2 PKCS and imported PKCS profiles for S/MIME and the remaining application certificates
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Endpoint engineering Source: ../books/b07-pki/06-device-and-user-certificates.md#pkcs-and-imported-pkcs-profiles

Task.Name: K4.3 Staged rollout extended to further user populations as sign-in data supports, within the 10-group limit
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Identity engineering Source: ../books/b07-pki/06-device-and-user-certificates.md#staged-rollout

Task.Name: K4.4 AD CS autoenrollment for MIGRATE templates removed on each ring once its devices hold valid cloud certificates
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: PKI and CA administrators Source: ../books/b07-pki/07-coexistence-and-migration.md#renewal-while-two-issuers-overlap

Task.Name: K4.5 Server certificates (internal TLS, RADIUS, VPN gateways, SQL Server) discovered and enrolled for automated renewal; renewal owner recorded per class
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Server and network teams Source: ../books/b07-pki/08-lifecycle-monitoring-and-decommissioning.md#inventory-and-renewal-through-cyberark-certificate-manager

Task.Name: KG4 Gate 4 — Every managed device on cloud certificates
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: CISO and ISSO Criteria: Every managed device holds cloud-issued certificates for its MIGRATE use cases; every user intended for CBA on it; AD CS autoenrollment for MIGRATE templates removed on every migrated ring; server certificates renewing through the CLM platform Source: ../books/b07-pki/07-coexistence-and-migration.md#the-migration-playbook

Task.Name: Wave 5 — Cutover
D-K3 Convert the federated domains to managed authentication, and in what order
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Executive sponsor and CIO Options: A test domain or the domain with the fewest users first, then the rest; hold a domain on federation as a dated exception If decided late: AD FS stays in the sign-in path with certificate authentication on, and Gate 5 waits Source: ../books/b07-pki/07-coexistence-and-migration.md#the-migration-playbook

Task.Name: K5.1 No unexpired AD CS certificates left on managed devices for MIGRATE use cases; federation settings recorded; AD FS backed up with Rapid Restore
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Identity engineering Source: ../books/b07-pki/07-coexistence-and-migration.md#the-migration-playbook

Task.Name: K5.2 Domains converted one at a time; staged rollout groups removed; AD FS certificate authentication off
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Identity engineering Source: ../books/b07-pki/06-device-and-user-certificates.md#migrating-from-ad-fs-certificate-authentication

Task.Name: K5.3 AD CS procedures revised to BRIDGE and RETAIN scope only: domain controllers, LDAPS, NPS, server TLS
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: PKI and CA administrators Source: ../books/b07-pki/04-the-target-pki.md#ad-cs-retained-for-what-only-it-can-do

Task.Name: KG5 Gate 5 — Cut over
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: CISO and ISSO Criteria: All target domains managed; AD FS certificate authentication off; CBA working for all users; no AD CS certificates on managed endpoints for MIGRATE templates; BRIDGE and RETAIN templates documented and running Source: ../books/b07-pki/07-coexistence-and-migration.md#the-migration-playbook

Task.Name: K5.4 Rollback window: AD FS restorable but out of the sign-in path for 30 days; application use watched in Connect Health and the sign-in logs
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Identity engineering Source: ../books/b07-pki/07-coexistence-and-migration.md#rollback-rules-that-hold-across-waves

Task.Name: X-P45S Program starts moving user and device issuance off AD CS (start of P4.5)
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform teams (program) If decided late: The program retires smart-card logon and AD CS issuance before the cutover has proved the cloud path Source: program-master-schedule.md

Task.Name: Wave 6 — Decommission
X-P45 User and device issuance off AD CS; smart-card logon GPO retired (program P4.5)
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform teams (program) If decided late: MIGRATE-only components still issue, and decommissioning can't start Source: program-master-schedule.md

Task.Name: D-K4 Retire each MIGRATE-only AD CS component
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Executive sponsor and CIO Options: Retire, starting with the CA with the fewest dependents, once nothing depends on it; keep it as a dated exception under the hardening baseline If decided late: NDES, CES/CEP and MIGRATE-only issuing CAs stay in service into the program's AD retirement Source: ../books/b07-pki/08-lifecycle-monitoring-and-decommissioning.md#decommissioning-ad-cs

Task.Name: K6.1 Nothing depends on the CA, from the CLM inventory and the CA database; issuance stopped; events 4886 and 4888 read for a week
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: PKI and CA administrators Source: ../books/b07-pki/08-lifecycle-monitoring-and-decommissioning.md#decommissioning-ad-cs

Task.Name: K6.2 CA database and key backed up and archived; outstanding certificates revoked; the final CRL published to outlive them
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: PKI and CA administrators Source: ../books/b07-pki/08-lifecycle-monitoring-and-decommissioning.md#decommissioning-ad-cs

Task.Name: K6.3 Role services uninstalled before the CA role; the CA removed from the Entra trust store, Intune profiles and NTAuth
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: PKI and CA administrators Source: ../books/b07-pki/08-lifecycle-monitoring-and-decommissioning.md#decommissioning-ad-cs

Task.Name: K6.4 Decommission record committed; the archive's disposition set under the records schedule
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Records officer Source: ../books/b07-pki/08-lifecycle-monitoring-and-decommissioning.md#the-evidence-an-assessor-reads

Task.Name: KG6 Gate 6 — MIGRATE-only components retired
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: CISO and ISSO Criteria: MIGRATE-only AD CS components retired or archived; offline root retained and documented, with the CA that signed the cloud issuing CA under BYOCA; no orphaned autoenrollment GPOs; HTTP CDP and AIA kept until the last certificate expires; decommission record in the evidence repository Source: ../books/b07-pki/07-coexistence-and-migration.md#the-migration-playbook

Task.Name: X-G4 Program G4 — Legacy Quiet
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Steward (backup: executive sponsor; program) If decided late: The program reaches Legacy Quiet with MIGRATE-only CAs still running Source: program-master-schedule.md
